entities.name: Jesus of Nazareth
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jewish preacher and religious leader (c. 4 BCE – c. 30 CE) in Roman Palestine. His teachings on love, forgiveness, and the Kingdom of God founded Christianity, which became the world's largest religion.
